chapter: Failure in St. Louis and the Omaha bands
title: Floyd Ray's band and its three girl singers
summary: Floyd Ray had a well-organized section band with three girl singers and a hit record of Three O'Clock in the Morning.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I'm sure it was. Well, you went to Floyd Ray's band from -- you moved to California with Floyd Ray's band. Well, what was Floyd Ray's band like?

Floyd Ray had an excellent band, musical band, and entertaining. He had three singers with him, three girl singers. Three girl singers, and they had made a famous record called 'Three O'Clock in the Morning.' A beautiful arrangement. He had several very good arrangers from the west coast who were writing for the band, and he had great musicians in the band. Good, very good organized group.
I don't remember all of their names.
Any that perhaps ended up on the east coast?
